review:
Horse racing again, with a two-path bonus. Three to five scatters trigger it, then you pick one of 12 cards to decide between regular Free Spins and Golden Cup Free Spins.

Regular spins play like classic Big Bass. Golden Cup clears everything except money symbols, wilds and blanks off the reels, which really concentrates the action. Either way, every fourth wild adds 10 spins and a higher multiplier: 2x, 3x, then 10x. 96.07% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
